vendor_api_version: Xero Accounting API 2.0 as served 2026-09-28, spec 19.0.0

divergences.route: GET /connections, GET /Connections and every authenticated route
divergences.reason: By default any non-empty bearer token is accepted. Xero refuses a token it did not issue with a 401 and www-authenticate Bearer error=invalid_token. strict_auth (the --strict-auth flag, or PUT /admin/config) restores Xero's behaviour.
divergences.operator_note: Added for the named target localstack/finance-ops, which seeds a made-up token per test (tests/conftest.py seed_xero_token) and relies on xero-local accepting any bearer. Becomes operator-approved when WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin-docs#261, which adds slice xero-bp1-s24, is merged.

divergences.reason: By default a refresh token this emulator never issued is taken as a fresh sign-in and answered with a new token pair. Xero answers invalid_grant. A refresh token that was issued and already redeemed is refused either way, so single use holds. strict_auth restores Xero's behaviour.
divergences.operator_note: Same reason as the bearer divergence: localstack/finance-ops seeds xero-local-test-refresh. Becomes operator-approved when WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin-docs#261 is merged.

divergences.reason: A xero-tenant-id header is required, as on Xero, but by default an unknown tenant id is accepted and sees an empty tenant. Xero refuses a tenant the token cannot reach with a 403. strict_auth restores the 403. The 403 body itself is a guess at Xero's problem-details shape: the real one is not observed.
divergences.operator_note: Same reason as the bearer divergence: localstack/finance-ops sends its own tenant id (tests/conftest.py XERO_TENANT_ID) and relies on xero-local not checking it. The default tenant id is finance-ops's value, so its own calls reach seeded data.

divergences.reason: A delivery that fails is retried a fixed number of times, at a fixed delay, by the kit's dispatcher, and then dropped. A subscription is never disabled and missed events are never held or replayed. Xero retries immediately, then every 15 minutes for up to 24 hours, then disables the subscription and replays held events for 31 days on re-enable.
divergences.operator_note: Scope exception granted by the operator on 2026-10-19: deferred to xero-bp2 (WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin-docs#270). The named target localstack/finance-ops uses no Xero webhooks.

divergences.route: outbound webhook deliveries: payload shape and intent to receive
divergences.reason: Details the research does not settle are guessed. Each delivery carries one event, with firstEventSequence equal to lastEventSequence. eventType is uppercase (CREATE, UPDATE). eventDateUtc has three fractional digits, as in the documented example. The intent-to-receive check sends four requests (signed, unsigned, signed, unsigned) and enables the subscription only if the receiver answers 2xx to the signed and 401 to the unsigned.
divergences.operator_note: Settling these needs a live delivery (quirk observe_via: traffic). Recorded in WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin-docs#270.

divergences.reason: Only Contact.ContactID is read. Xero looks a contact up or creates one by name when no ContactID is sent, and updates the contact record from any other contact field sent in the document. Here an invoice with no ContactID, or an unknown one, is refused, and the other contact fields are ignored. localstack/finance-ops always sends a bare ContactID, because the second behaviour is why it reduces the contact to its id.
divergences.operator_note: Raised while building s09 (invoice create). Becomes operator-approved when the plan amendment that splits xero-bp1-s09 is merged.

divergences.reason: TaxAmount on a line is the TaxAmount the client sent, or 0. Xero computes it from the tenant's tax rate for the line's TaxType, and tax rates (TaxRates) are not modelled in xero-bp1, so no rate is applied and Total equals SubTotal unless TaxAmount is sent. TaxType values are accepted unvalidated.
divergences.operator_note: Raised while building s09 (invoice create). Becomes operator-approved when the plan amendment that splits xero-bp1-s09 is merged.

divergences.reason: EnteredTotal and RoundingAmount (new in spec 19.0.0) are stored as sent and not used: Xero checks the computed total against EnteredTotal and applies RoundingAmount, which this build does not.
divergences.operator_note: Raised while building s09 (invoice create). Becomes operator-approved when the plan amendment that splits xero-bp1-s09 is merged.

divergences.reason: A line with no UnitAmount and any DiscountRate or DiscountAmount is refused with a validation error. Xero's LineAmount is net of discount, so the gross cannot be recovered from LineAmount alone; what Xero does with this shape is unverified, so refusing is a guess.
divergences.operator_note: Raised while building s09 (invoice create). Becomes operator-approved when the plan amendment that splits xero-bp1-s09 is merged.

divergences.reason: Only Status DELETED is read from a payment update; any other status is refused, and other updatable fields are ignored. A payment that is already DELETED or reconciled is refused, and an unknown payment is a 404. The wording of these refusals is a guess. The deleted payment stays in the tenant, and its invoice returns to AUTHORISED with the amount due restored; whether Xero keeps the deleted payment in the invoice's Payments is unverified, and here it is dropped.
divergences.operator_note: Raised while building s13 (delete payments). Becomes operator-approved when s13 is reviewed.

divergences.reason: Only a payment against an invoice or a credit note is supported: a payment that names a Prepayment or Overpayment is refused with a ValidationException. Xero records these too; the plan does not cover them.
divergences.operator_note: A scope boundary of xero-bp1, not a decision about Xero. Tracked for xero-bp2 in the plan's deferred list.

divergences.reason: BankAmount equals Amount and CurrencyRate is stored as sent, so a payment never converts between the invoice currency and the bank account's currency. Xero converts by the rate.
divergences.operator_note: A guess made where the research is silent; multi-currency payments are not modelled.

divergences.reason: By default an inline Allocation is accepted against an AUTHORISED or PAID invoice of the same contact and type, bounded only by the credit note's total: AmountCredited grows, AmountDue never goes below zero and a PAID invoice stays PAID. Both rules are guesses; the research has one example (part of an AUTHORISED credit note against an outstanding invoice) and does not say what Xero does with a PAID invoice or an amount above AmountDue. strict_auth (the --strict-auth flag, or PUT /admin/config) refuses an invoice that is not AUTHORISED and an amount above its AmountDue.
divergences.operator_note: Added for the named target localstack/finance-ops, whose refund flow (backend/stripe_xero_lambda/xero_client.py _create_refund_credit_note) allocates the whole refund to an invoice that is normally already PAID. Whether real Xero accepts that is unverified.

divergences.reason: By default a payment on a credit note is accepted when the credit note is AUTHORISED or already PAID and the payments on it add up to no more than its Total; the payment lowers RemainingCredit (never below zero) and the credit note becomes PAID at zero. Both rules are guesses; the research does not cover refund payments. strict_auth (the --strict-auth flag, or PUT /admin/config) requires an AUTHORISED credit note and an amount within RemainingCredit.
divergences.operator_note: Added for the named target localstack/finance-ops, whose refund flow (backend/stripe_xero_lambda/xero_client.py create_payment) allocates a credit note to an invoice in full and then pays the credit note's whole total as ARCREDITPAYMENT. Whether real Xero accepts that sequence is unverified.

divergences.reason: Xero has no health or reset endpoint. These two paths are control-plane aliases for GET /admin/health and POST /admin/reset, served so a consumer written for the legacy xero-local emulator can use this one unchanged. They are not Xero API, and no other xero-local control path (such as /_xero/state) is aliased.
divergences.operator_note: Added for the named target localstack/finance-ops, whose Makefile services-wait polls /_xero/health and whose reset_xero_state fixture posts /_xero/reset before each test (tests/conftest.py at 8ff5f6b).

divergences.reason: A contact that carries the ContactID of a stored contact is updated, with only the fields the body carries changed, and one with no ContactID is created by the rules of PUT /Contacts. Whether Xero also matches a Name that belongs to another contact is not settled by the research (reports disagree), so this emulator never does: such a Name is refused as PUT refuses it. A ContactID that matches nothing answers a 404 whose body is a guess. These rules are a guess until a sandbox observes them.
divergences.operator_note: Added so the legacy xero-local create-by-POST can be replaced. xero-local's own upsert by Name is deliberately not reproduced: it is not Xero behaviour (WonderTwin-AI/wondertwin-docs research/twins/xero/feature-gap-register.md GAP-007).

divergences.reason: An invoice that carries the InvoiceID of a stored invoice is updated by the rules of POST /Invoices/{InvoiceID}, and one with no InvoiceID is created by the rules of PUT /Invoices. Whether Xero also matches on InvoiceNumber is not settled by the research, so this emulator does not: a number that belongs to another invoice is refused as PUT refuses it. An InvoiceID that matches nothing answers a 404 whose body is a guess and writes nothing. These rules are a guess until a sandbox observes them.
divergences.operator_note: Added so the legacy xero-local create-by-POST can be replaced; finance-ops test_create_invoice_and_payment posts to the collection.

divergences.reason: A credit note that carries the CreditNoteID of a stored one is updated, and one with no CreditNoteID is created by the rules of PUT /CreditNotes. An update is partial, may move the status DRAFT or SUBMITTED to AUTHORISED or DELETED, SUBMITTED back to DRAFT, and AUTHORISED to VOIDED, and the lines, totals and status of a credit note with credit applied or paid are fixed and it cannot be voided. Allocations sent on an update are refused for now (a later slice adds them); inline Allocations on a create work as on PUT. Whether Xero also matches on CreditNoteNumber, and every one of these update rules, are guesses: the research has no example of a credit note update. A CreditNoteID that matches nothing answers a 404 whose body is a guess and writes nothing.
divergences.operator_note: Added so the legacy xero-local create-by-POST can be replaced; finance-ops test_create_credit_note posts to the collection.
